support_tolerance.estimate: 2.5 * 1.4826 * MAD of signed, reciprocal, interior train residuals in the same reference-Z bin

fusion.local_model_surface: predicted optical Z, validated by native sensor; B2 legacy supported mesh for fallback
fusion.local_sensor_surface: native sensor Z, separate sensor-only product

training.trigger: any supported, nonidentity pose, reliability-weighted supervision or localized subdivision change measured on training observations; otherwise skip_equivalent

depth_weighting.weights: (1+S)/(1+S+C); S=independent surface support groups, C=reliable free-space conflict groups
depth_weighting.activation: Nonidentity effective weights and larger independent training residuals in lower-confidence pixels; log cross-group comparison and counts.
depth_weighting.empty_support: w=1 when S=C=0; empty directional loss mask contributes zero
depth_weighting.invariant: All-one weights reproduce both B2 directional loss terms and gradients

texture.fallback: No extra split when source imagery is unclear, evidence is misaligned or contributing Gaussian IDs cannot be determined reliably

selection.checkpoint: exact B2 210k val RGB noninferiority, then min pooled Z MAE, max PSNR, earliest; if none, B3 final as diagnostic
selection.model_promotion: RGB gate and pooled val depth MAE <= B2 210k; otherwise retain B2
selection.model_mesh_candidates: legacy supported Poisson, legacy model TSDF and new model surface for each available primary model; exclude sensor-only outputs
selection.mesh_promotion: hit>=0.90, correct10 >= B2 supported and foreground <= B2 supported, all on val; then all three goals, max correct10, min foreground, min hit MAE, incumbent on exact tie
selection.test: only after all choices have been frozen; full 184 development test once per distinct deliverable
